title: 冻结生产数据库 schema 所有权与迁移底座
risks: The new Ubuntu PostgreSQL 16.15 GitHub Actions job has not yet executed remotely; local Windows evidence covers the same migration, backup, restore, concurrency, drift and privilege paths.
The backup role is deliberately NOBYPASSRLS; any future RLS-protected business table needs an explicit full-backup policy and restore test before release.
Archive SHA-256 detects corruption and mismatch but not provenance; operations must protect archive and metadata together as one trusted backup unit.
A PostgreSQL patch upgrade requires an explicit manifest, CI image and exact integration-evidence update; cross-major execution remains rejected.

reused_existing_logic: M0-005 PostgreSQL 16.15, transactional DDL, advisory-lock, checksum and task-local cluster evidence without promoting its Spike business tables
M0-009 handoff, architecture baseline, three-tier CI and v0.1-start gates
PostgreSQL native roles, schemas, default privileges, pg_dump and pg_restore
Python 3.12 standard library for deterministic connection-free validation and test orchestration
contract_changes: Internal production database contract adds a checksum-pinned manifest, 26 fixed NOLOGIN roles, 11 module schemas, migration ledger and read-only privilege projection; no business tables
Internal fast-merge contract adds connection-free database checks on existing runners and one independent Ubuntu PostgreSQL 16.15 service job without adding a fourth CI tier
Production migration SQL and manifest bytes are fixed to LF for cross-platform SHA-256 stability
architecture_tests: 21 static database manifest, safety, backup-contract and frozen-Spike tests
5 PostgreSQL 16.15 integration tests for forward/reapply, concurrency, drift, atomic failure, least privilege, backup, restore and replay
Repository verifier, handoff validator, architecture baseline, v0.1-start release gate, git diff check and Python cache-residue gate
technical_debt: Retain the first remote Ubuntu PostgreSQL 16.15 fast-merge evidence after merge.
Define and prove backup behavior before any future owner enables row-level security.
Add business tables, data access and workload-specific indexes only in their assigned V01-004/V01-005 ownership tasks.
Refresh the frozen patch, image and evidence deliberately when PostgreSQL 16 receives a reviewed servicing upgrade.
